# SD18 deterministic Human Cleric level 16 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Cleric
# level-1..level-15 prepared divine spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/fixtures/rules_core/pf1_human_cleric_level15_sd18_widening_deterministic_input.txt)
# to level 16 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic
# ability/feat posture from the level-1 through level-15 fixtures, and the
# same canonical domain selections (Good, Healing), adding only the level
# bump this bounded slice needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Cleric burden surface: no spellbook, no
# spells prepared, no spell slots, no spell DCs, no bonus spells, no domain
# power execution beyond the flat facets already grounded at levels 1-15, no
# domain spell-list contents, and no level-17+ progression. The PF1 CRB
# Cleric class table's level-16 "Special" column is genuinely BLANK
# (verified independently against both d20pfsrd and the Archives of Nethys
# aonprd.com mirror, byte-for-byte agreement — the next Channel Energy
# die-count rise, at the odd-level cadence, does not land until 17th level):
# base attack bonus genuinely rises to +12 (16 * 3 / 4 = 12, up from 11 at
# level 15), good Fortitude/Will genuinely rise to +10 (16 / 2 + 2 = 10, up
# from 9 at level 15), while poor Reflex stays +5 (16 / 3 = 5, an
# integer-division coincidence with level 15). Channel Energy's die count
# stays 8d6 ((16 + 1) / 2 = 8, an integer-division coincidence with level
# 15, since the die-count rises only at odd cleric levels) and the flat
# domain spell slot count stays 8 (a level-16 cleric still casts only up to
# 8th-level cleric spells; 9th-level cleric spells are out of this bounded
# ceiling's scope). The Good domain's Touch of Good sacred bonus genuinely
# rises to 8 (16 / 2 = 8, up from 7 at level 15) via the same pre-existing
# formula, not re-derived.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-cleric-level16

race_id=race:human
class_level=class:cleric:16
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:good
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:healing
